review_candidates.title: Quality Monitoring Specialist B1+ call center
review_candidates.description_excerpt: The specialist is responsible for monitoring and evaluating customer interactions across calls and other channels to ensure adherence to quality standards, policies, and procedures. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills to review data, identify trends, and provide actionable insights. Candidates should possess Quality Control and Quality Assurance skills to ensure adherence to service standards and client requirements.
eligibility_evidence: The organization is widely recognized with multiple international awards in outsourcing excellence, customer experience, sustainability, diversity, equity, inclusion, and impact sourcing.
Xceed is also certified in key international standards for quality, business continuity, information security, environmental management, and occupational health and safety.
Role Description The Quality Monitoring Specialist B1+ call center role at Xceed is a full-time on-site position based in Cairo.
